prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions were consistently too high across all tests compared to noise-corrected outcomes.
Evidence is still too thin to establish rules for specific kinds of changes, as no change type has been tested at least twice.
No kind of change has been proven helpful yet, as no test has yielded a statistically significant win.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_flow: -2.3% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- adoption, redesign: -1.4% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, new_flow: +1.9% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, new_screen: -3.9% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, reorder: -6.2% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 17.8%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [choose_path, redesign] Choose Path Spotlight Redesign: Redesign the choose_path screen into a spotlight layout to highlight path options clearly. (why: 23.8% of users drop out on choose_path, taking a median of 8s and mean of 514s.)
1: [adoption, redesign] Adoption Certificate Split Layout: Redesign the adoption certificate screen to a split layout showing the pet preview alongside adoption details. (why: Adoption drop-off is 39.1% with long completion times (mean 1017s).)
2: [finish, new_flow] Interactive Welcome Tour Flow: Add a new welcome tour step right after home_intro explaining how to interact, hide, and summon the pet on desktop. (why: 3 support emails reported confusion on controlling or talking to the pet, and 35.2% drop at the finish step.)
3: [home, wait_info] Waiting Screen Generation Progress Timer: Show a time estimate and helpful tips carousel on the waiting screen during pet generation. (why: The waiting screen has a mean time of 2336s (median 201s), causing users to abandon or wait idly.)
4: [choose_path, hint] Path Selection Guidance Hint: Display a explicit hint under path options reassuring users they can change their choice in settings later. (why: Decision friction on choose_path leads to long mean duration (514s) and 23.8% abandonment.)
5: [sign_in, copy] Sign In Safe Restore Headline: Update the sign-in screen headline and body text to clarify that signing in protects save progress across logins. (why: 8 support emails cited reset or missing pet data after signing back in.)
6: [home, notification] Desktop Ready Notification Opt-in: Add a desktop notification switch to the waiting screen so users get notified when generation finishes. (why: High mean wait duration on home (2336s) indicates users switch away while waiting.)
7: [adoption, layout] Pick Friend Stage Layout: Switch the pick_friend screen to a stage layout to showcase pet options prominently. (why: The adoption step has high drop-off (39.1%) and high time taken (mean 1017s).)
